scope: /events?closed=false&limit=100&order=volume24hr 内嵌 markets; 单页 markets/keyset limit=100 作为补充; 分页不可用故非全市场
method: sum-of-legs arbitrage | negRisk-only + complete-set-only + active-only(zombie-quote filtered) + fee-included + page1-limit100 (pagination BROKEN) | fee model: fee_per_share = rate * p * (1-p)  [OFFICIAL: docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees -> fee = C x feeRate x p x (1-p)]; rate from market feeSchedule (0.04~0.05 observed); cross-validated on 42 real positions, median 2.52% of notional
fee_model: fee_per_share = rate * p * (1-p)  [OFFICIAL: docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees -> fee = C x feeRate x p x (1-p)]; rate from market feeSchedule (0.04~0.05 observed); cross-validated on 42 real positions, median 2.52% of notional
fee_source: OFFICIAL: https://docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees -> fee = C x feeRate x p x (1-p); rate table: https://help.polymarket.com/en/articles/13364478-trading-fees
filter_chain: complete set (every leg has bestBid AND bestAsk)
active-only (no closed/archived/active=false leg = no zombie quotes)
fee deducted: sum over legs of rate*p*(1-p)
scope = page 1 only (limit=100); pagination BROKEN so NOT the whole market
caveats: 只保留 event.negRisk=true 且所有腿都有双边报价、且无僵尸腿(closed/archived/active=false)的集合
negRisk=false 的集合腿之间可能不互斥, Σ 无意义 (实测 Σbid 最高 66.885, 327 腿)
单页扫描会漏腿 -> 假套利 (实测 NBA 2027 冠军只扫到 2/36 腿 -> 假 +99.5%); 本文件已用 /events 规避
僵尸报价 = 已 closed/archived 的腿仍返回 bestBid/bestAsk; 实测 NBA 2027 冠军 36 腿中 6 腿是僵尸, 把 Σbid 抬到 1.0200 造成名义 +2.00% 假套利 -> 已在 rejected_sets 单列该原因
bestBid 在 100 市场样本中缺失 7~8%, 缺一条腿的报价即判定集合不完整
分页 next_cursor 实测不可用(回传同页 100/100), 本扫描不是全市场 —— 扫描范围 = /events 第一页 100 个事件(内嵌 6249 市场) + keyset 第一页 100 市场; 命中率(0/9, 0/10)不可外推为全市场比例
feeSchedule 缺失时按 rate=0.05 兜底(实测 14~15% 市场无该字段)
